title: UPS-backed cameras and links for remote installations

scenes.headline: When the grid fails and the generator is slow to start, what keeps recording?
scenes.voice: At a remote site, the grid fails often, and the generator takes time to start. In that gap, the systems that protect the site can drop, and the evidence goes with them.

scenes.headline: The loads that protect the site.
scenes.voice: Cameras and recorders, the communication link back to base, and the control equipment that monitors the plant. These are the loads that cannot be allowed to drop.

scenes.headline: Ride-through sized from your real load.
scenes.voice: FOG Technologies Nexus designs UPS backup for these critical loads. We measure the real load of each cabinet, size the UPS to carry recorders, switches and links through every changeover, test it with your team, and check its health remotely afterwards.

scenes.headline: Request an executive briefing
scenes.voice: Request an executive briefing on resilience for your remote sites. Write to CEO at fogtechnexus.space.
